• Brand introduction: 

2020: while everyone else baked banana bread, Manpreet and Andy were busy perfecting their skincare rituals. Swapping chemical-laden formulas for nature's finest, they discovered that radiant skin and a clear conscience weren't mutually exclusive – in fact, they were the perfect pairing. Plant-powered ingredients soothed and nourished their skin, and their new skincare routines aligned with their growing passion for sustainability and ethical sourcing.

But their newfound passion for clean beauty soon hit a snag. Building a routine felt like an endless scavenger hunt – the sustainable, vegan and cruelty-free products they sought were scattered across countless online stores. They dreamt of being able to find everything in a one-stop-shop that embodied their values, but such a sanctuary was proving hard to locate.

So, they took matters into their own hands. Frustration turned into fuel, sparking the idea for bonnyLeaf.
Their vision was to establish an online haven where natural skincare seekers could shop with confidence. They wanted customers to know that every product followed bonnyLeaf’s ‘green beauty’ checklist, including:

☑ Plant-powered
Harnessing the potency of botanicals, leaving harsh chemicals behind.

☑ Vegan & cruelty-free
Because compassion is always beautiful.

☑ Eco-conscious
From ingredients to packaging, we tread lightly on the earth.

☑ Transparent
No hidden nasties, just good-for-you ingredients with clear labelling.

The mission? To empower you to make informed, sustainable choices for your skin and the planet. To inspire a shift towards a more conscious and compassionate beauty industry. bonnyLeaf is starting out with its own line of consciously crafted skincare, formulated in partnership with Senior Formulation Chemist Priscilla Randrianarison. Think simple yet powerfully effective, with transparency and sustainability at the heart of every bottle.

Manpreet and Andy’s ambitions don't stop in their own lab. Soon, they hope that bonnyLeaf will become the go-to destination for clean skincare – bridging the gap between you and a curated collection of other forward-thinking and earth-friendly brands out there. Because a healthy complexion shouldn't come at the cost of the planet.
